name: Docling-Serve
description: ### What is Docling? Docling is an open-source toolkit (from IBM Research) that converts documents (PDF, DOCX, images, HTML, etc.) into structured Markdown or JSON. It's great for RAG and local document processing. **Highlights** - Multi-format parsing with layout understanding and table extraction. - Simple API + optional Web UI. - Runs locally on your Unraid box; keep your data private. **Default Endpoints** - API: `http:// :[PORT:5001]` - Docs: `http:// :[PORT:5001]/docs` - Web UI: `http:// :[PORT:5001]/ui` (set `DOCLING_SERVE_ENABLE_UI=1`) **Permissions** - The template runs the container with `--user 0` so first-run model downloads can write to appdata on any Unraid ownership. If you removed it and see `PermissionError`/`Errno 13`, either add `--user 0` back in Extra Parameters or run `chown -R 1001:1001 /mnt/user/appdata/docling` from the Unraid host. **First-Run Model Download** - On a fresh install the models directory will be empty. Docling must download RapidOCR and other artifacts on first boot. - First run downloads models from upstream model hosts (e.g., HuggingFace); needs outbound HTTPS. - After the first successful start and model cache is populated, you may set `DOCLING_SERVE_ENABLE_REMOTE_SERVICES` back to `false` if you prefer a fully local-only deployment. - Keep `DOCLING_SERVE_LOAD_MODELS_AT_BOOT=true` so any download failures show up immediately in startup logs rather than at first OCR request. **Image Size** - The image is large (up to ~8 GB) — make sure the docker image share has free space before installing. **Persistent Paths** - Models/artifacts are persisted in appdata so restarts do not re-download everything. - If logs show `artifacts_path is set to an invalid directory`, verify the models path exists and matches `DOCLING_SERVE_ARTIFACTS_PATH`.

paths.name: Docling Models Path
paths.description: Persistent Docling model artifacts (required; must exist and be writable; must match DOCLING_SERVE_ARTIFACTS_PATH)

variables.name: Load Models At Boot
variables.description: Preload/download models at startup (recommended for easier first-run diagnostics).

variables.name: Enable Remote Services
variables.description: Allow remote model/service calls. Enabled by default so first-run model downloads work automatically. Set to false after initial setup if you prefer fully offline operation.

variables.name: Artifacts Path (env)
variables.description: Directory used by Docling to load/store model artifacts

variables.name: Force Device
variables.description: Runtime device: auto, cpu, cuda, cuda:0, mps. Use 'auto' to let Docling decide. For CPU-only, select the cpu image branch above.
